exempt.reason: The plan editor's ProseMirror keymaps move the caret between blocks and out of the first line.
With nothing focused, the arrows select a block of the plan document: editor navigation, not a list.
A popup of the plan editor: Home, End and → stay the editor's caret and word keys while the menu is open.
A popup of the plan and comment editors: Home, End and → stay the editor's caret keys while the menu is open.
Arrow keys are bytes sent to the pty (⌘← and ⌘→ become line start and end), never a focus move.
